claims.evidence_en: The herbicide tembotrione, chemical name: 2-{2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl}cyclohexane-1,3-dione, is a triketone-class maize-field herbicide developed by Bayer in 2007; its activity is higher than that of nitrosulfone/mesotrione (mesotrione, methyl sulcotrione), and it is safe to the crop. Tembotrione is used mainly in maize fields; it is a post-emergence HPPD (4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase) inhibitor herbicide, which can block the biosynthesis of prenyl (isoprenoid) quinones inside the plant, causing chlorosis, discoloration and tissue necrosis, and finally death within 2 weeks. Tembotrione has a broad weed-control spectrum and a long window of application; its main targets are the various broadleaf weeds and grass weeds of the mid-to-late post-emergence stage in maize fields, and it has excellent efficacy against thistle, field bindweed, speedwell, gallant soldier, hemp-nettle and cleavers, causes no phytotoxicity to the succeeding crop, and is one of the most important herbicides in United States maize fields, with a maximum application rate of 100 g/hm2 per season; the main formulation type is: oil dispersion (dispersible oil suspension concentrate). Volume 56, issue 5 of 《Nongyao》 (Pesticides) reported a synthesis process for the maize-field herbicide tembotrione. In synthesising methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, elemental bromine, which is comparatively hazardous, was used as the brominating agent; in synthesising 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, sodium methoxide was used as a raw material, and sodium methoxide is flammable, explosive and sensitive to air and moisture, decomposing rapidly on contact with water into methanol and sodium hydroxide, so the conditions for its use in an industrial process are demanding; in the synthesis of tembotrione acetonitrile was used, and acetonitrile belongs to the controlled, moderately toxic chemicals, and because it is extremely volatile it again in the production process readily causes chronic poisoning accidents.

claims.evidence_en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost. Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost. evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

Volume 56, issue 5 of 《Nongyao》 (Pesticides) reported a synthesis process for the maize-field herbicide tembotrione. In synthesising methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, elemental bromine, which is comparatively hazardous, was used as the brominating agent; in synthesising 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, sodium methoxide was used as a raw material, and sodium methoxide is flammable, explosive and sensitive to air and moisture, decomposing rapidly on contact with water into methanol and sodium hydroxide, so the conditions for its use in an industrial process are demanding; in the synthesis of tembotrione acetonitrile was used, and acetonitrile belongs to the controlled, moderately toxic chemicals, and because it is extremely volatile it again in the production process readily causes chronic poisoning accidents.

claims.evidence_en: The herbicide tembotrione, chemical name: 2-{2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl}cyclohexane-1,3-dione, is a triketone-class maize-field herbicide developed by Bayer in 2007; its activity is higher than that of nitrosulfone/mesotrione (mesotrione, methyl sulcotrione), and it is safe to the crop. Tembotrione is used mainly in maize fields; it is a post-emergence HPPD (4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase) inhibitor herbicide, which can block the biosynthesis of prenyl (isoprenoid) quinones inside the plant, causing chlorosis, discoloration and tissue necrosis, and finally death within 2 weeks. Tembotrione has a broad weed-control spectrum and a long window of application; its main targets are the various broadleaf weeds and grass weeds of the mid-to-late post-emergence stage in maize fields, and it has excellent efficacy against thistle, field bindweed, speedwell, gallant soldier, hemp-nettle and cleavers, causes no phytotoxicity to the succeeding crop, and is one of the most important herbicides in United States maize fields, with a maximum application rate of 100 g/hm2 per season; the main formulation type is: oil dispersion (dispersible oil suspension concentrate). The herbicide tembotrione, chemical name: 2-{2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl}cyclohexane-1,3-dione, is a triketone-class maize-field herbicide developed by Bayer in 2007; its activity is higher than that of nitrosulfone/mesotrione (mesotrione, methyl sulcotrione), and it is safe to the crop. Tembotrione is used mainly in maize fields; it is a post-emergence HPPD (4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase) inhibitor herbicide, which can block the biosynthesis of prenyl (isoprenoid) quinones inside the plant, causing chlorosis, discoloration and tissue necrosis, and finally death within 2 weeks. Tembotrione has a broad weed-control spectrum and a long window of application; its main targets are the various broadleaf weeds and grass weeds of the mid-to-late post-emergence stage in maize fields, and it has excellent efficacy against thistle, field bindweed, speedwell, gallant soldier, hemp-nettle and cleavers, causes no phytotoxicity to the succeeding crop, and is one of the most important herbicides in United States maize fields, with a maximum application rate of 100 g/hm2 per season; the main formulation type is: oil dispersion (dispersible oil suspension concentrate). Title of invention: A synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione

Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. claims.evidence_en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost. Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost. evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

claims.claimed_en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

claims.claimed_en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

claims.claimed_en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

claims.claimed_en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

claims.claimed_en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

Volume 56, issue 5 of 《Nongyao》 (Pesticides) reported a synthesis process for the maize-field herbicide tembotrione. In synthesising methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, elemental bromine, which is comparatively hazardous, was used as the brominating agent; in synthesising 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, sodium methoxide was used as a raw material, and sodium methoxide is flammable, explosive and sensitive to air and moisture, decomposing rapidly on contact with water into methanol and sodium hydroxide, so the conditions for its use in an industrial process are demanding; in the synthesis of tembotrione acetonitrile was used, and acetonitrile belongs to the controlled, moderately toxic chemicals, and because it is extremely volatile it again in the production process readily causes chronic poisoning accidents.

Drawn on the page: 1 structure. C17H16ClF3O6S (CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)C2C(=O)CCCC2=O)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F).

34.72 g of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid (99.8%, 0.1 mol), 0.74 g of DMF (99%, 0.01 mol), 24 g of thionyl chloride (99%, 0.2 mol) and 100 ml of dichloroethane are charged into a 250 ml reaction flask; the temperature is raised and the mixture is reacted at reflux, and after the reaction is finished the solvent is stripped off completely. 22.6 g of 1,3-cyclohexanedione (99%, 0.2 mol) and 100 ml of dichloromethane are charged into the reaction flask, and 30.6 g of triethylamine (99%, 0.3 mol) is added dropwise at 5 to 10 C, followed by LC until the reaction is complete. After the reaction is complete, 0.89 g of acetone cyanohydrin (95%, 0.01 mol) is added, followed by LC until the reaction is complete. After the reaction is complete, water is added and the mixture is washed with water and the layers separated; the oil layer is stripped of solvent completely, ethanol is added for recrystallisation, and the product is filtered and dried to give 38.1 g of a beige crystalline powder, purity 98.7%, yield 85.4%.

claims.evidence_en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost. Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

claims.evidence_en: The herbicide tembotrione, chemical name: 2-{2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl}cyclohexane-1,3-dione, is a triketone-class maize-field herbicide developed by Bayer in 2007; its activity is higher than that of nitrosulfone/mesotrione (mesotrione, methyl sulcotrione), and it is safe to the crop. Tembotrione is used mainly in maize fields; it is a post-emergence HPPD (4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase) inhibitor herbicide, which can block the biosynthesis of prenyl (isoprenoid) quinones inside the plant, causing chlorosis, discoloration and tissue necrosis, and finally death within 2 weeks. Tembotrione has a broad weed-control spectrum and a long window of application; its main targets are the various broadleaf weeds and grass weeds of the mid-to-late post-emergence stage in maize fields, and it has excellent efficacy against thistle, field bindweed, speedwell, gallant soldier, hemp-nettle and cleavers, causes no phytotoxicity to the succeeding crop, and is one of the most important herbicides in United States maize fields, with a maximum application rate of 100 g/hm2 per season; the main formulation type is: oil dispersion (dispersible oil suspension concentrate). claims.evidence_en: Volume 56, issue 5 of 《Nongyao》 (Pesticides) reported a synthesis process for the maize-field herbicide tembotrione. In synthesising methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, elemental bromine, which is comparatively hazardous, was used as the brominating agent; in synthesising 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, sodium methoxide was used as a raw material, and sodium methoxide is flammable, explosive and sensitive to air and moisture, decomposing rapidly on contact with water into methanol and sodium hydroxide, so the conditions for its use in an industrial process are demanding; in the synthesis of tembotrione acetonitrile was used, and acetonitrile belongs to the controlled, moderately toxic chemicals, and because it is extremely volatile it again in the production process readily causes chronic poisoning accidents. Title of invention: A synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione

Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione, comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

Background art:
Background art:

The herbicide tembotrione, chemical name: 2-{2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl}cyclohexane-1,3-dione, is a triketone-class maize-field herbicide developed by Bayer in 2007; its activity is higher than that of nitrosulfone/mesotrione (mesotrione, methyl sulcotrione), and it is safe to the crop. Tembotrione is used mainly in maize fields; it is a post-emergence HPPD (4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase) inhibitor herbicide, which can block the biosynthesis of prenyl (isoprenoid) quinones inside the plant, causing chlorosis, discoloration and tissue necrosis, and finally death within 2 weeks. Tembotrione has a broad weed-control spectrum and a long window of application; its main targets are the various broadleaf weeds and grass weeds of the mid-to-late post-emergence stage in maize fields, and it has excellent efficacy against thistle, field bindweed, speedwell, gallant soldier, hemp-nettle and cleavers, causes no phytotoxicity to the succeeding crop, and is one of the most important herbicides in United States maize fields, with a maximum application rate of 100 g/hm2 per season; the main formulation type is: oil dispersion (dispersible oil suspension concentrate).
